correctness.rationale: Rotation symmetry and direct edge second-moment integration yield K_n(x,y)=1+[6/(2+cos(2π/n))]x·y. Convexity of its L1 norm in the evaluation point bounds all perimeter points by vertex values; strict sign disagreement between adjacent vertex kernels on a positive-measure arc excludes edge interiors. At a vertex the kernel values change sign between integer indices J−1 and J, J=ceil(n/3); exact negative edge integrals consist of a full negative-vertex cosine sum minus two fractional crossing-edge triangular deficits amounting to ab/(a+b). This gives the closed finite-n expression. Taylor expansion in h=2π/n with d=J−n/3 in {0,2/3,1/3} produces the stated common positive n^-2 term and n mod 3 cubic correction. Fresh high-precision independent direct edge integration for every n=3..100, rational n=3,4,6, and n≈30000 across all congruence classes corroborated the formula and cubic sign.

value.rationale: The exact endpoint operator norm is a natural stability and positivity-defect invariant for least-squares approximation on polygonal meshes. The arithmetic n mod 3 term distinguishes discrete polygon boundaries from their smooth circle limit and from vertex-only sampling, and the explicit sharp norm is applicable across every n≥3 rather than an arbitrary finite slice.

final_claim: Sharp L1/L∞ operator norm of the L2 affine projector for normalized arclength on a regular n-gon perimeter, attained at vertices only, with positive n^-2 defect and a sign-sensitive n^-3 correction by n modulo three.
limitations: No monotonicity claim; cubic defect is a uniform n→∞ asymptotic, not an exact finite monotonicity guarantee.
